source: prd.md Acceptance Criteria AC3 and AC5, fixed before any Isaac run

definitions.zero_command_note: stance_hold.py COMMAND_DEADBAND on max |admitted_command|; the stand_probe case admits exactly zero
definitions.planar_drift: largest XY distance of base_xyz from the first FIXED_STAND row
definitions.torque_clip_step: a row with torque_clip_joint_count > 0 (computed vs applied torque, last physics substep)
definitions.time_to_fixed_stand: first FIXED_STAND row sim_time_s minus the start of the zero-command interval that contains it
definitions.entry_steps: the first STAND_TRANSITION row of each entry and the row after it (new gains act in the next step)
definitions.rejoin_steps: every REJOIN row and the two rows after each REJOIN segment
definitions.nonfoot_violation: any non-foot force at or above the limit (runner contact guard semantics) or any recorded over-threshold event

ac3_stand.run: stand_probe, 60 s, --stance-hold auto; the --stance-hold off run is a baseline without thresholds

ac7_entry.added: 2026-09-17 before the C1 rerun, PRD D4
ac7_entry.run: every stance-hold run (stance_hold auto), stand and two-goal
ac7_entry.entry: a metrics.jsonl row with stance_mode STAND_TRANSITION whose previous row is not STAND_TRANSITION
ac7_entry.window: for each entry, the rows whose sim_time_s lies in [t0, t0 + window_s], both ends inclusive, where t0 is the entry row's sim_time_s
ac7_entry.window_tolerance_note: 5 percent of the 20 ms control period; recorded sim_time_s is float32-derived
ac7_entry.missing_field: a window row without base_linear_velocity_world fails the check as not evaluable
ac7_entry.restart: the first metrics.jsonl row after the entry row whose stance_mode is neither STAND_TRANSITION nor FIXED_STAND (normally the first REJOIN row, or RL after a direct exit); that row and every later row are excluded from the window; the window still ends at t0 + window_s (window_tolerance_s at the end) when that comes first

amendment.quote: Change the AC7 rule to stop the evaluation window at a restart, and explicitly label it as a post-result change in the report.
amendment.trigger: C2 episode 6 (two_goal_20260918T030524Z_hold_e06): the hold entry at step 332 was followed by a resumed command; the V12 restart peaked at 0.174 rad/s inside REJOIN, within 1.0 s of the entry
amendment.unchanged: the limits, the entry definition, window_s and window_tolerance_s; AC8 b (ac8_walk.b_entry_windows) keeps the full window [t0, t0 + window_s]
amendment.reporting: every report gives the amended verdict, labelled as a post-result change, and the verdict as frozen before the results (the full window) with the full-window maxima

ac8_walk.added: 2026-09-17 before any scripted-walk run, PRD D5
ac8_walk.run: case scripted_walk with the frozen command script and --camera-preset side; one --stance-hold off baseline and one or more --stance-hold auto runs (--stance-entry-kd ramp, step1, step2p5, or xfade1s, xfade2s (PRD D6)); AC5 and AC7 also apply to every run

command_script.rule: a run whose scripted_walk_setup.json (or summary scripted_walk) names another SHA-256 fails AC8 d

ac8_walk.phase_rule: phases are the contiguous metrics.jsonl rows whose admitted_command is zero (max |value| <= definitions.zero_command_max_abs) or not; they must match the listed phases in order, with the listed non-zero commands (1e-6) and, when rows carry script_segment, the phase index; a phase's command step t_c is the sim_time_s of the row before its first row (0 for the first phase) and must lie within command_step_tolerance_s of start_s; the last zero phase ends at finish_request_s and the run must reach it; later rows are reported as post-finish

a_fixed_stand.rule: every zero phase has a stance_mode FIXED_STAND row among its rows, that is before the next non-zero command, or at or before finish_request_s for the last phase

b_entry_windows.rule: every ac7_entry window of the run passes with the ac7_entry limits, unchanged

c_start.window_rule: rows with t_c < sim_time_s <= t_c + window_s + window_tolerance_s
c_start.nonfoot_rule: max of nonfoot_force_max_n and nonfoot_force_substep_max_n over the window, and any summary nonfoot_contact_events_over_threshold inside the window, must stay below the limit
c_start.pitch_excess_rule: max |pitch| of the hold-on start window minus that of the same start of the hold-off run

d_run.rule: summary.json present with a completed status and case scripted_walk; the four event counters are 0; case_failed and contact_guard.failed are false; no stance hold failure; no non-finite value in metrics.jsonl; the frozen command script; planar travel within the relative bound of the hold-off run
d_run.planar_travel: XY distance from the first to the last metrics.jsonl row (net displacement); path length is reported beside it

reporting.note: reported for every run, the hold-off baseline included, without thresholds
reporting.time_to_still: start of the first run of rows, inside the zero phase, that meets both still limits continuously for still_duration_s, minus t_c
reporting.time_to_fixed_stand: first FIXED_STAND row sim_time_s in the zero phase minus t_c (hold-on runs)
reporting.phase_tail: rows in the last phase_tail_s of the zero phase: max |yaw_rate_radps|, max horizontal_speed_mps and the largest XY distance from the first tail row
reporting.start_window: the c_start window: max |pitch|, max |roll|, max |base_linear_velocity_world[2]|, the lowest base_xyz[2] minus its value at t_c, and the largest non-foot force
reporting.walk_phase_distance: XY distance from the row at t_c to the last row of the non-zero phase

selection.rule: among stance_hold auto runs whose AC5 and AC8 verdicts pass, select the one with the lowest max |yaw_rate_radps| over all of its ac7_entry windows; ties go to the earlier --on argument; if none passes, or the hold-off baseline is not valid, report and stop with no selection
